RM Need To Return To Supplier
RM Need To Return To Supplier

## Section 1: Overview

### Screen Name
Common GDI – Return to Supplier (New Screen)

### Business Requirement
To allow Raw Material (RM) Return to Supplier through Common GDI even when the RM is allocated to another SOC, without requiring manual de-allocation from the SOC beforehand.
This enhancement is required to reduce operational delays caused by SOC re-allocation and re-QC rejection scenarios.

### Business Scenario
Currently, RM received from a supplier is allocated to an SOC. In cases where:
• Another SOC delivery/PCD is prioritized, or
• Material fails re-QC after allocation
the RM gets allocated to a different SOC.
As per the current system behavior, such allocated material does not appear in Common GDI – Return to Supplier, and cannot be returned unless the material is first freed from the SOC — which is time-consuming and causes rework.

### Type
New Development (Common GDI – Return to Supplier screen only)

### Target Audience
Warehouse Users

### Required Action Points (Common GDI Only)
• Allow RM return through Common GDI – Return to Supplier even if the material is allocated to another SOC.
• Display stock allocated to other SOCs against the same source GRN on the Common GDI – Return to Supplier screen.
• Enable both Returnable and Non-Returnable flows from the Common GDI screen.
• Mandatory remarks to be captured and logged for GDI, GDN, and GRN transactions in all scenarios.

## Section 2: Solution Design

### Navigation
Inventory → Dispatch Instruction → Common GDI – Return to Supplier

### Visibility Rule (New)
• Stock allocated to any SOC other than the source GRN SOC must be visible and selectable on the Common GDI – Return to Supplier screen.
• Visibility should be based on Source GRN, irrespective of current SOC allocation.

## Functional Behavior – Common GDI Return to Supplier

### A. Non-Returnable Type
When returning RM via Common GDI – Return to Supplier for Non-Returnable type:
• Unreservation Logic
• Selected quantity must be automatically unreserved from the allocated SOC / MRL.
• No manual SOC freeing should be required.
• Indent Log Maintenance
• Stock correction will have the GDI information.
“Due to GDI: <GDI Number>”
• Pick List / GDI Cancellation Handling
• If Pick List is canceled and GDI is canceled:
• Quantity will be available as free stock and will not be auto allocated in prev indent/oc.
• Indent Status Update
• Indent status must be updated accordingly after unreservation.
• Stock must be unreserved from the allocated indent.

### B. Returnable Type
When returning RM via Common GDI – Return to Supplier for Returnable type:
• Indent Handling
• Indent must be moved back to Active status.
• Material must be unreserved from the indent automatically.
• Indent Log Maintenance
• Indent log entry must be create a stock correction and that stock correction will have the GDI information.

### Logging & Audit Requirements (Common GDI Only)
• Mandatory remarks to be captured at:
• GDI creation
• GDN generation
• GRN reversal / return
• All unreservation and status changes must be traceable through system logs.

### Out of Scope
• No changes to the existing Return to Supplier screen behavior.
• No manual SOC de-allocation process required from users.
